---
# The canonical web home of the lab guidelines.
#
# This page holds NO prose of its own. The text lives in _guidelines/, one file
# per version, and this file just includes the current one -- so there is exactly
# one source to edit and tools/build_guidelines_pdf.py reads that same file.
# To publish a new version, bump the filename on the `include` line below.
#
# _guidelines/ is underscore-prefixed on purpose: Quarto skips those folders, so
# the superseded drafts sitting next to the current one never become pages. They
# used to live at the repo root, where all three rendered as /lab-guidelines-vX.Y.html
# and went into sitemap.xml -- three competing versions of the same document.
pagetitle: "Lab Guidelines — BioM2 Lab"
description: "What to expect in the BioM2 Lab: how we work, what members can expect from the PI and from each other, and how to join."
page-layout: article
toc: true
toc-title: "Contents"
toc-depth: 2          # sections only; the 2.1/3.2-style subsections would triple its length
# The included file opens with its own H1, version line and byline, because it is
# also read straight from GitHub. Here that block would sit directly under
# Quarto's own title block and repeat it, so the filter strips it -- the same cut
# tools/build_guidelines_pdf.py makes before handing the body to Typst.
filters:
  - _filters/guidelines-title.lua
---

{{< include _guidelines/lab-guidelines-v3.3.md >}}
